in_sanskrit.name: दर्शना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दृष्टिरूप (vision), सेन्द्रिय (sense organ), आत्मा वा कोई अवतार (soul or god in a form), देखने वाला (one who sees) के लिए अर्थ (meaning) है।

in_marathi.name: Darshana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे View, Sight, Vision
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darshana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who gives a divine view or vision. A seer, a beholder, a witness. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘drsh’, meaning to see. In Hindu mythology, Darshana refers to the divine vision granted to the devotees upon attaining spiritual enlightenment.

in_bengali.name: Darshana
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ View, Sight, Vision
in_bengali.long_meaning: Darshana একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who gives a divine view or vision. A seer, a beholder, a witness. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘drsh’, meaning to see. In Hindu mythology, Darshana refers to the divine vision granted to the devotees upon attaining spiritual enlightenment.
